candidate.definition_en: Standing out so as to be clearly visible; attracting notice.
candidate.explanation_ar: واضح جداً وملفت للنظر، أي حد ياخد باله منه بسهولة لأنه مختلف أو ظاهر.

senses.definition_en: Standing out so as to be clearly visible; attracting notice.
senses.definition_ar: واضح وجلي للعين أو ملفت للانتباه بسهولة.
examples: Her bright clothes made her conspicuous in the crowd.
He was conspicuous by his absence at the wedding.
The bird's plumage makes it conspicuous to predators.
